<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/cases/{caseId}/classify/{jobId}/reviews"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



accept confirms the chosen code and correct supplies the right one; both write the record label with labelSource review in the knowledge base and take effect directly, so the product becomes evidence for later runs. A correction also adds a correction memo entry. feedback only stores a memo entry and never changes classification. Model proposals are never written back. Rows without a key and matching jobs record the review and memo entry but no record. The label write is asynchronous: labelWrite reports its state, and a repeated identical request returns the same review. Requests carrying the agent actor marker may only leave feedback.
